scope: Finite static shared-world relational semantics; generated validation only

two_bit_grid.signatures: all 255 nonempty subsets of eight atoms
two_bit_grid.costs: Fixed basis vectors [1,0] and [0,1]; zero-cost cases are separate unit tests

hypotheses: deterministic feedback and K+1 retrieval outcomes suffice for rejection
negative_controls: three-atom exhaustion-evidence erasure: H=2 versus K=1 passes only after projection, while H=3 versus K=1 fails
Boolean and floating-point aliases in serialized positive-world metadata are malformed

support.selection: 258 evenly spaced families per support: range(0,65536,255), including both endpoints; exact generator authoritative

cover_split_mutations.missing_child: remove one child from a real binary coverage split; replay must reject
cover_split_mutations.duplicated_child: replace the second branch by a duplicate of the first while retaining arity; replay must reject

graphs.grammar: all call-depth-at-most-two trees with two binary keys and two return labels

larger_selection: Exact included generator; fixed before execution; not held-out real applications. All selected cases and worlds retained.

worst_cost_oracle.comparison: enumerate terminal operational traces; compare the attained componentwise maximum with Theorem 5.7

scaling.binary_record_interpretation: worst_formula is symbolic arithmetic; the separate three-branch oracle is the executed cost comparison

failure_policy: Mismatch stops comparison; malformed is not invalid; UNKNOWN has no semantic conclusion; no favorable-result filtering.

adapter_boundaries.target_horizon: strict non-Boolean integer in 1..H, checked before state construction
adapter_boundaries.module_boundary: bits=4 admits 17 nominal modules; bits=5 requires 33 and returns UNKNOWN
adapter_boundaries.retrieval_outcome_boundary: 32 outcomes admitted; 33 returns UNKNOWN without deleting branches
adapter_boundaries.node_boundary: a fixed exact expansion has five nodes; a test-only ceiling of 5 admits it and a test-only ceiling of 4 returns UNKNOWN, exercising the construction off-by-one without claiming a natural 1000-node fixture
adapter_boundaries.semantic_preservation: no nominal feedback key is merged and no feedback or retrieval branch is removed
